newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - UNITED ARAB EMIRATES - March 22.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - UNITED ARAB EMIRATES - March 22.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- UAE President Sheikh Zaid bin Sultan al-Nahayan receives Sudanese President Oman Hassan al-Bashir.
- De Beers has no plans for Gulf office.
- Gulf Craft set to launch new model.
- Sudan hails Sheikh Zaid's peace initiative.
- National Bank of Abu Dhabi profits rise by 100 million dirhams in 1996.
- Sheikh Zaid reiterates UAE's desire to help maintain Sudan's unity and stability. Bashir hails UAE efforts to settle differences.
